address: 1502 Lake Osborne Dr, Lake Worth, FL 33461
address_note: Task brief listed zip 34461, which is not a valid Florida zip in the Lake Worth area. Booksy JSON-LD, localmint.com and thumbtack.com all independently confirm 33461, so 33461 was used on the site and in JSON-LD (verified data over the brief).
rating_source: Booksy (verified via JSON-LD on the business's live Booksy page)
secondary_social_proof: 98% recommended, 32 reviews on Facebook (per task brief; Facebook page fetch only returned the page title, could not independently re-verify the percentage/count, used as given since it was pre-verified in the discovery phase)

reviews_named.author: Roxana H.
reviews_named.body: It was a great first experience for my poodle he is 4 months old. They did a great job!

reviews_named.author: Gayle P.
reviews_named.body: They are very professional and kind. My dog does not feel nervous at all when he goes there. In fact, he feels excited about going and they do a great haircut and blowout for my doodle.

reviews_unnamed_material: Even sent pics as the grooming was happening to approve. Very friendly facility w/lots of love.
Absolutely love bringing my dogs to Doggie Paws Salon! Wanda and her team are the sweetest and do such a great job taking care of my fur babies.
Wanda is amazing. You can tell she loves what she does.
Very attentive and treat me fur baby with care
